policy_decision.rationale: Multi-candidate routing search as currently configured with seed derivation and deterministic Weighted placement produces identical physical SWAP counts and depths across all evaluated budgets (0/24 cases improved, 24/24 unchanged, 0/24 worsened), while incurring an ~9.2x compilation time growth factor at B=16. Because SABRE routing heuristics in QCC use a deterministic 5-tier tie-breaking hierarchy, varying seeds without varying initial layout heuristics produces identical search trajectories. Therefore, deterministic single-candidate routing (Budget=1) must remain the default, with multi-candidate routing remaining strictly opt-in.
